## Teaching Plan {#teaching-plan}

**Engineering Thermodynamics: Introduction**

| Week | Topic | Main focus |
|:----:|:------|:-----------|
| 1 | First law of thermodynamics | System, energy, heat, work, mass and energy conservation |
| 2 | Properties of fluids | Volumetric and thermodynamic* properties of fluids, phase-change, ideal gas state processes, sensible and latent heat |
| 3 | Second law of thermodynamics | Entropy, entropy in open systems, losses and efficiency, third law of thermodynamics |
| 4 | Additional topics | Instructor-led topics, student-led review of key projects |

: {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[8,30,62]"}

## Data Resources {#data-resources}

Specific data sources to be used during the course.

### Thermochemical and property data

- [**NIST Chemistry WebBook**](https://webbook.nist.gov/chemistry/){target="_blank"}: coefficients of the Shomate equations for $c_p$, $h$ and $S$, with enthalpies of formation and combustion.
- [**NIST WebBook: Fluid Properties**](https://webbook.nist.gov/chemistry/fluid/){target="_blank"}: multi-phase fluid property data.

### Enthalpy of formation and reaction

- [**Calctool: Enthalpy**](https://www.calctool.org/thermodynamics/enthalpy){target="_blank"}: online calculator for enthalpy of formation and reaction.
- [**Active Thermochemical Tables (ATcT), Argonne National Laboratory**](https://atct.anl.gov/Thermochemical%20Data/version%201.228/index.php){target="_blank"}: critically evaluated thermochemical data (version 1.228).

## Recommended Books {#recommended-books}

::: {.callout-note}
Any textbook prescribed by your institute is suitable. The books below are additional references that students may find useful.
:::

| Book title | Author(s) | Publisher | Edition / availability |
|:-----------|:----------|:----------|:-----------------------|
| Engineering Thermodynamics | P.K. Nag | McGraw Hill India | 7th edition; Indian edition |
| Engineering Thermodynamics | R.K. Rajput | Laxmi Publications | Multiple editions; Indian publication |
| Thermodynamics: An Engineering Approach | Yunus A. Cengel, Michael A. Boles, Mehmet Kanoglu | McGraw Hill | 10th edition (2025); Indian edition available |
| Fundamentals of Thermodynamics | Claus Borgnakke, Richard E. Sonntag | Wiley | 10th edition (2022); Indian edition available |
| Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics | Michael J. Moran, Howard N. Shapiro, Daisie D. Boettner, Margaret B. Bailey | Wiley | 8th edition; SI/Indian edition available |
